description: REDCap external module: Project MICA. Runtime dependencies only - see tools/composer.json for the test toolchain.

check:vendor: git diff --exit-code -- composer.lock vendor ':(exclude)vendor/composer/installed.php' ':(exclude)vendor/composer/installed.json' || (echo '' && echo 'vendor/ is out of date - commit the result of the install above.' && exit 1)

scripts-descriptions.lint: PSR-12 over the phase-3 code (scope and exclusions in phpcs.xml).
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Auto-fix what phpcs can fix; re-run `composer lint` after.
scripts-descriptions.test: Lint then unit tests. Run before every commit; every stage must leave it green.
scripts-descriptions.check:vendor: Prove the committed vendor/ is what composer.json resolves to. Run after ANY dependency change - vendor/ is committed and baked into the REDCap image verbatim, so a stale tree passes every test and then ships. Requires a clean working tree. installed.php/installed.json are excluded because composer stamps the current git SHA into them, so they differ on every commit regardless of dependencies.
